authors.name: E. Stanley Busby
authors.bio: E. Stanley Busby Jr. was born in Portsmouth, Virginia, in September 1927. His career spans 14 years in broadcasting at WTAR in Norfolk, Virginia, followed by 21 years with Ampex Corp. The last 16 years have been spent in engineering, mostly in quadruplex video recorder design. He has been a member of the SMPTE for two decades and is the author of an important tutorial on digital video that appeared in the July 1975 Journal. Currently Mr. Busby is Manager of the Audio Engineering Department at Ampex.
